name: Geometric median and spherical mean of N latents
plain: Two ways to average many latents without plain-mean norm collapse. Geometric median uses Weiszfeld iterations and resists one outlier. Spherical mean averages unit directions per channel and rescales to the mean norm. Pack is a lab pack in the local library; core/freq.py etc. are absent from the patched copy.
math:
median: est₀=mean; wᵢ=1/‖xᵢ−est‖ (min EPS); est=Σwᵢxᵢ/Σwᵢ; up to 24 iterations, stop at allclose 1e−6
spherical: per channel, flatten, u=x/‖x‖, d=mean(u), out=d/‖d‖·mean(‖x‖)
